set.body:
Outcome: ListView and TreeView share TableView keyboard-visible border; ordinary focus keeps the decorative border. Report https://github.com/canardlapin/meridianfx/issues/5 at cf5bbff69203556ee8b31ea566502d502e766386. Scope: one generic focus recipe, four generated themes/manifests, native DataFocusProbe and bounded evidence; no selection palette change (#4), docking/provider/pin change or broad accessibility qualification.
Acceptance:
- [ ] Reproduce missing list/tree ring and existing table ring on native JavaFX before editing.
- [ ] All four compiled themes give list/tree/table the 2px semantic focus-ring border only in focus-visible state; ordinary focus and clearing focus-visible restore decorative1px border.
- [ ] Native regression checks computed border colors/widths and actual focus ownership for all three controls in both densities/schemes; captures and commands/exits retained.
- [ ] Theme regeneration is byte-verified; relevant Python/native smoke checks pass; scope and limitations documented.
Checks: baseline/corrected native probe, independent theme compilation/byte check, Python theme/token suite and ThemeSmoke. Pseudo-class render evidence does not establish OS input/screen-reader qualification.
set.title: Fix native ListView/TreeView focus-visible ring (#5)
